title: Cross-seed divergence assertion is vacuous w.r.t. growth — seed-99 spawn positions computed then discarded
detail: ha/hc are full per-tick state hashes that diverge for ANY two seeds (rng/demand draws differ) regardless of growth; seed-99 growth positions nc are discarded. A growth implementation ignoring the rng still passes — the claimed proof is unproven.
recommended_fix: Assert na vs nc differ (growth spawn positions/counts across seeds 42 vs 99), making seed-dependent GROWTH divergence the actual failure condition.

title: Era-parse fail-loud guard ('growth on' + era 0) has zero test coverage
detail: The briefing's claimed era-parse fail-loud proof has no test: the harness package contains zero @(test) procs (verified) and no demo exercises the rejection; a silent-acceptance regression would bless no-growth goldens unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Add a parse_demo unit test asserting the growth-on+era-0 rejection string (and the malformed 'growth' variant), mirroring the core acceptance-pin convention.

title: E31 rejection-budget exhaustion branch (window skip after 8 invalid candidates) is unpinned
detail: GROWTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS appears nowhere in growth_test.odin (verified); only the accept-first-valid path is exercised. Deterministic budget exhaustion (skip window, never a wall-time loop) could regress silently.
recommended_fix: Add a crowded-map test asserting a spawn window deterministically skips after 8 invalid candidates (no spawn, no hang) and replays byte-identically.
